notes: Prototype connections cannot cross Figma pages; agents build per page, then frames are moved onto one Prototype page and wired at the end.

search_design_system: no reusable components in subscribed libraries (M3/SDS/Apple kits); everything local.
figma.createAutoLayout() frames get a default opaque white fill; always set fills=[] on containers. resize() on a TEXT node after textAutoResize=HEIGHT resets it to NONE; set HEIGHT after resize.
Paints from setBoundVariableForPaint with a black base sometimes render black; use the variable's resolved colour as the base colour.

Illustrations I3 (2026-09-24): Light path, Bias, Darks and Flats share one drawing: a star's rays converge onto the Pixel Grid layer of a single sensor chip (Pixel Grid -> Amplifier -> ADC), bracketed 'Layered Camera Sensor'; no image-file box. Bias highlights the ADC (read offset/noise come from the converter; there is no separate readout board). Darks highlights Pixel Grid + Amplifier (heat in both). Flats shows the optical path: an edge-of-field star partly blocked by the tube (dim corners) and dust on the filter; the divide-equals triptych was removed. Groups are named telescope/focuser/camera/filter/sensor chip/light/callouts inside each component's 'drawing' frame.
